title: Implement Python semantic compiler

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 bounded non-executing semantic compiler selection only
scope.implementation_delta: The current datasets source forest already supplies the Python v1 compiler. This receipt selects that authority; it does not create a proof_context wrapper, a second parser, a competing symbol/CID authority, a source-map authority, or an M2/M3 mutation path.

determinism_and_boundaries: The analyzer parses source with ast and never executes the source it examines.
Facts are sorted by stable symbol ID and duplicate logical bindings are rejected instead of receiving invented identities.
The shared frontend owns parsing, lexical scopes, declarations, diagnostics, and unsupported-construct notices; the analyzer adds semantic-index projection only.
Dynamic execution, reflection, constructed attributes, native boundaries, monkey patches, metaclass mutation, and runtime code generation downgrade confidence rather than being claimed exact.
The compiler is bounded Python AST analysis, not whole-CPython semantic equivalence, runtime tracing, a proof system, or a canonical PCSM source-map authority.
selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: The existing current-head implementation supplies Python-v1 static compilation, versioned schemas, CID-bound source/symbol identities, fail-closed dynamic-feature classification, and positive/negative test coverage. Reimplementing it inside proof_context would duplicate authority and violate this task's receipt-only output boundary.

source_inventory.role: non-executing parser, lexical scope/declaration authority, diagnostics, source spans, and resource limits
PythonSemanticAnalyzer, source-CID, facts/edges, and dynamic-feature confidence classification
stable-symbol and version-CID payload construction plus position-free AST normalization
closed versioned semantic-index, symbol, source-span, edge, state, and invalidation schemas
deterministic pack-CID and stale/unavailable/opaque fail-closed coverage

assertions: Equivalent function bodies differing only in indentation retained the same version CID.
The exact input emitted a source CID and the function emitted stable and version CIDs bound to selected schemas.
eval was classified opaque with an explicit reason rather than promoted.

positive_coverage: deterministic declaration and scope extraction with source-span support

limitations: This task is receipt-only: it selects existing current-head compiler authority and does not create a competing compiler or mutate proof_context/.
The selected compiler is bounded static Python AST analysis; it does not establish whole-CPython runtime semantics, dynamic import results, reflection, native behavior, or generated-code correctness.
The source/symbol CIDs are valid only under the bound datasets source digests and stated schema/version; any change invalidates this receipt.
The authoritative sealed suite remains unavailable because anyio is absent, so this receipt cannot promote completion.
The receipt's own canonical storage CID is unavailable because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.

rollback.procedure: Revert only this receipt and invalidate consumers of this PCSM compiler selection. Do not alter the selected datasets source forest, protected policy documents, or prior admitted history.
